rows.headline: Oil prices jump as US and Iran trade attacks over Strait of Hormuz
rows.prelim_note: Commodity/macro + supply-demand: Brent +4.14% to $79.16/bbl and WTI +2.97% to $74.38/bbl after a fourth wave of US strikes on Iran and Iranian missile/drone retaliation against Bahrain, Kuwait and Jordan; the Strait of Hormuz (~1/5 of global oil trade) is now near-standstill, with war-risk insurance up to 3-5% of vessel value.

rows.headline: SK Hynix Shares Plunge Most on Record in Deepening Korea Selloff
rows.prelim_note: Shifts analyst expectations: SK Hynix fell 15.37% (its biggest one-day decline on record) and Samsung Electronics 10.7% after Korea Investment & Securities flagged SK Hynix's Q2 operating profit at ~KRW60.4tn, roughly 8% below the ~KRW65tn consensus; the KOSPI dropped as much as 9%, triggering a circuit breaker.

rows.headline: Samsung Brings Forward Yongin AI Chip Fab Launch to 2029
rows.prelim_note: Supply/demand: Samsung moves the start-up of its first Yongin fab 1-2 years earlier to 2029 (from 2030-31), part of South Korea's plan to double memory capacity within 5 years — bears directly on whether the AI memory-chip cycle is at a supply peak or still building.

rows.headline: PepsiCo shares fall as slight earnings miss overshadows revenue beat
rows.prelim_note: Earnings/margin: Q2 adjusted EPS of $2.20 missed the $2.21 consensus by $0.01 on North America margin pressure; shares fell 3.19% premarket even as revenue beat ($24.18bn vs $23.97bn est.) and management flagged full-year EPS trending to the low end of its range. Dated July 9 — outside the strict last-24h window but not yet in the ledger.

rows.headline: Kroger Announces Agreement to Acquire Giant Eagle
rows.prelim_note: Capital structure/M&A: $1.65bn deal ($1.25bn cash plus ~$400m assumed liabilities) for privately-held Giant Eagle's supermarket business changes Kroger's regional footprint, balance sheet and competitive position in the Midwest/Northeast. Dated July 8 — outside the strict last-24h window but not yet in the ledger.
